lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when testing a reducer fold that sets a field assert against a value distinct from the input state s prior value asserting the block s label same after rewording it to same or comparing replay log only to a project built incremental lets a fold that stops writing the field pass green
lessons.text: When testing a reducer/fold that sets a field, assert against a value distinct from the input state's prior value — asserting the block's label 'same' after rewording it to 'same', or comparing replay(log) only to a project-built incremental, lets a fold that stops writing the field pass green.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::spec ac listing row record fields each row shall include the author is satisfiable two ways a dedicated column or a field inside the serialized payload the implementation chose the latter author lives in operation json flag which one the ac means at design time
lessons.text: Spec AC listing row/record fields ('each row SHALL include the author') is satisfiable two ways — a dedicated column or a field inside the serialized payload; the implementation chose the latter (author lives in operation JSON). Flag which one the AC means at Design time.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when idempotency has a dedicated ledger marker and redundant downstream no op guards add a test that removes the marker and asserts the effect re derives otherwise a regression that drops the marker check passes ci
lessons.text: When idempotency has a dedicated ledger/marker AND redundant downstream no-op guards, add a test that removes the marker and asserts the effect re-derives — otherwise a regression that drops the marker check passes CI.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for a shall not call x again idempotency edge case spy on x and assert call count 1 across retries asserting only the end state one entity reused id passes even when the guard is removed
lessons.text: For a 'SHALL NOT call X again' idempotency edge case, spy on X and assert call-count == 1 across retries; asserting only the end-state (one entity, reused id) passes even when the guard is removed.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a test asserts an error classification drive the input so only the correct branch reaches the asserted outcome e g an always failing 429 forces the retry ladder to exhaust a short script where the schema retry and ladder walk paths both succeed proves nothing
lessons.text: When a test asserts an error CLASSIFICATION, drive the input so only the correct branch reaches the asserted outcome (e.g. an always-failing 429 forces the retry ladder to exhaust); a short script where the schema-retry and ladder-walk paths both succeed proves nothing.

lessons.key: gate_fail::a verifier sub agent with isolation worktree can land on a stale base checkout seen slice 0 tip no node modules before trusting any gate result check git rev parse head feature branch tip and that node modules exists git reset hard branch pnpm install if not
lessons.text: A Verifier sub-agent with isolation:worktree can land on a stale base checkout (seen: slice-0 tip, no node_modules). Before trusting any gate result, check 'git rev-parse HEAD' == feature-branch tip and that node_modules exists; git reset --hard <branch> + pnpm install if not.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when an idempotency no op guard ands several equality clauses id and field a and field b add a test that varies each non id clause independently a test that only varies the id leaves the other clauses undiscriminated and flipping their to survives
lessons.text: When an idempotency/no-op guard ANDs several equality clauses (id AND field-a AND field-b), add a test that varies each non-id clause independently; a test that only varies the id leaves the other clauses undiscriminated and flipping their `===` to `!==` survives.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a shared guard covers several operation kinds assert the named rejection on each kind the spec lists not only on a representative kind
lessons.text: When a shared guard covers several operation kinds, assert the named rejection on each kind the spec lists, not only on a representative kind.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when incremental replay is specified for both snapshot and write model folds assert both replay equals project and replaywritemodel equals evolve not only the snapshot twin
lessons.text: When incremental-replay is specified for both snapshot and write-model folds, assert both replay equals project and replayWriteModel equals evolve, not only the snapshot twin.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an acceptance test only passes by loosening an e2e assertion tolerant the count is n today comments the defect is in the behaviour spec not the test fix the behaviour and keep the exact assertion
lessons.text: When an acceptance test only passes by loosening an E2E assertion (tolerant >=, 'the count is N today' comments), the defect is in the behaviour/spec, not the test — fix the behaviour and keep the exact assertion.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::error as success branches treating a specific error like duplicate id as success in a self heal path are invisible to happy path tests cover them by deterministically forcing the collision mock the id wipe the idempotency marker re run
lessons.text: Error-as-success branches (treating a specific error like duplicate-id as success in a self-heal path) are invisible to happy-path tests — cover them by deterministically forcing the collision: mock the id, wipe the idempotency marker, re-run.
